title: Magnetize
summary: MAG'NETIZE, verb transitive To communicate magnetic properties to any thing; as, to magnetize a needle. Seven of Deslon's patients were magnetized at Dr. Franklin's house. MAG'NETIZE, verb intransitiv

inlines.v: MAG'NETIZE, verb transitive To communicate magnetic properties to any thing; as, to magnetize a needle. Seven of Deslon's patients were magnetized at Dr. Franklin's house. MAG'NETIZE, verb intransitive To acquire magnetic properties; to become magnetic. A bar of iron standing some time in an inclined position, will magnetize
